_header: Retired-surface registry: the single source consumed by scripts/ci/retired_docs_gate.sh.
RULE: any PR that removes, renames, demotes, sunsets, or deprecates a
model-visible route, tool, profile, config key, env override, or code path
MUST add an entry here in the same PR. The gate scans active documentation
for teaching references to these terms and fails CI on them; historical
mentions that explicitly describe the term as removed/deprecated/legacy
pass (see the gate script header for the discriminator and its limits).
Entry fields:
term          exact identifier as active docs would teach it (tool name,
action string, config key, env prefix, or source path)
kind          tool | op | config-key | env-prefix | code-path
retired_in    the PR that retired it
notes         why it was retired and where the replacement lives
match_regex   optional refinement used instead of the default match when
the bare term collides with ordinary words or file
basenames; defaults: word-bounded exact match for
tool/op/config-key/code-path, prefix match for env-prefix.
In Fluent files the tool-<hyphenated-term> key form is
always matched on top of this
allowed_globs optional repo-relative globs that are never flagged for
this term (explicit bounded historical exemptions);
directory components must be literal, wildcards may
appear only in the basename (never spanning '/'), and
every component needs a non-wildcard character, so
blanket exemptions cannot be declared
replacement   optional replacement surface string (>= 4 characters,
no whitespace); when present, some active doc must teach
it (contain the string) or the gate fails - a rename may
not merely erase the old name
